calibration_source.selection_rule: first ranked cell with matches_base_scr_targets=true; ranking excludes all downstream sigma fit outcomes

generator.persistence_rule: for a rho fraction of repeat-detected individual-nights, replace all detector identities in that individual-night by one uniformly sampled detector identity already observed in that night; capture counts and occasions are unchanged

representations.CHECK: each physical trap check remains a separate multi-detector occasion

primary_metric: per replicate, 0.5*(abs(sigma_FIRST/sigma_CHECK-1)+abs(sigma_LAST/sigma_CHECK-1)); summarize its Monte Carlo mean in the calibrated scenario
secondary_metrics: max absolute FIRST/LAST deviation from CHECK
fraction of replicates with either nightly reduction >=10% from CHECK
CHECK relative error versus generating sigma
post-persistence repeat fraction, conflict fraction, and conflict diameter
